entities.summary: Douglas Francis Reinhardt is an American former baseball player, sports agent, and television personality. He is best known for playing minor league baseball with the Los Angeles Angels of Anaheim and Baltimore Orioles organizations, and for his appearances on the hit television show The Hills.
